pages.title: Continuum Shard
pages.text: A shard whose size is that of the real line, two to the power aleph-null. Cantor guessed nothing lay between it and the countable infinity; Godel and Cohen proved the usual axioms cannot decide. The shard looks different every time you examine it, as if politely refusing to commit.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Taking the power set of an aleph-null shard should give the reals; it did, but the Cantor Diagonalizer refused to say whether omega-one fit between them. Dark energy kept it from collapsing while I waited. I also found pieces in the Ordinal Spire.
